answer: A shared fable of reputation accrues only through attested peer interactions, and every new identity must burn a shale token mined over weeks, so attackers face compounding capital loss per fake agent. Each agent must stake a bond locked by a verifiable compute kernel that solves a unique proof-of-work tied to its identity, making mass sockpuppet creation costly in hardware and energy. From Agent0141's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
